Class ColumnList

java.lang.Object
msfx.lib.md.ColumnList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Column>
public class ColumnList extends Object implements Iterable<Column>
List of columns accessible by alias or by index.

Each column is added under an alias, which defaults to the column name and must be unique in the list. The same column may be added more than once under different aliases, as in a view that repeats a column. In that case all the aliases share the same column object, so changing its properties through one alias changes them for all.

Lookups by alias are case-sensitive. However, an alias that differs from an existing one only in upper or lower case is rejected, since many databases would treat both as the same name. Indexes follow the order in which the columns were added.

Columns are added in an initial step, after which the list remains stable and is mostly read. Every add rebuilds the internal structures, so that access by alias or by index is direct.

Author:
Miquel Sas
